plan: Given my value of $42, I aim to maximize my profit by bidding just below my valuation to outbid others without overpaying. Rational bidders will bid slightly below their values. I will bid slightly less than $42 to ensure a profit if I win, while still being competitive. I will bid $41.9, as it is high enough to likely win against rational opponents but ensures a profit if my bid wins.

Given my value of $29, I aim to bid slightly below it to maximize potential profit while avoiding overbidding. A rational bidder would not bid above their value. By bidding $28.9, I can outbid those valuing the prize near $28-$29, securing a win if their bid is lower. This maximizes profit while minimizing loss risk.

Given my value of $48, my optimal strategy is to bid slightly below my value to maximize profit while still having a high chance of winning. Since values are uniformly distributed, bidding $47.9 offers a strong chance of winning, as it is unlikely both other bidders value the prize higher. This bid maximizes profit if I win, as I will pay the second-highest bid, which is likely lower than $47.9.
